root_causes.failure: run_fast_checks.sh exited immediately with syntax error
root_causes.root_cause: Duplicate 'fi' on line 106 after the else block. Under 'set -euo pipefail', bash aborted on the syntax error before any checks ran.

root_causes.failure: 9 meta tests failed with TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable
root_causes.root_cause: backend/tests/generated/capability-registry.yaml contained YAML entries like 'engines:' and 'capability_tests:' with no value. PyYAML parses these as Python None. Downstream tools (change_intelligence.py, mutation_discovery.py, test_strength.py, selective_verify.py) iterate over these fields with cap.get('engines', []), which returns None when the key exists with value None. Iterating over None raised TypeError.
root_causes.responsible_module: Change Intelligence Framework (CIF) and meta test runners
root_causes.minimal_correction: Normalized 12 null list fields to [] in capability-registry.yaml. Added _normalize_registry() to check_coverage.py to prevent recurrence on regeneration.

root_causes.root_cause: Code style drift: production and test files were not formatted according to backend/pyproject.toml black configuration
root_causes.minimal_correction: Ran 'black .' from backend/ to auto-format all non-compliant files

root_causes.failure: Ruff lint check failed (9 SIM102 errors in scan_test_anti_patterns.py)
root_causes.root_cause: Deeply nested if-blocks checking AST node types violated ruff rule SIM102 (use single if statement instead of nested if statements)
root_causes.minimal_correction: Flattened nested isinstance() checks into combined 'and' conditions

root_causes.failure: python3 runtime/verify.py quick hung indefinitely / exceeded CI timeout
root_causes.root_cause: VerificationPlanner._merge_scopes() merged impacted scopes (BACKEND, CONTRACTS, RUNTIME, etc.) into the QUICK requested scope. This caused the planner to expand a lightweight 1-step profile into a 12-step full verification suite. Additionally, _collect_requirements() did not filter capability requirements by allowed scope, allowing out-of-scope requirements to be pulled in via capability dependencies. The orchestrator then executed all 12 steps sequentially, exceeding the CI 10-minute budget.
root_causes.minimal_correction: (1) Modified _merge_scopes() to exclude impacted scopes when requested scope is QUICK. (2) Modified _collect_requirements() to filter capability requirements by allowed scopes.
